prompt_head:
Job: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
- (required) Professional experience building and deploying production-grad

paragraphs.text: The Forward Deployed Engineer role asks for hands-on agent work that reaches customers. I build that way. Job Fit Agent is a LangGraph agent that ingests job postings daily from public APIs, scores each against an evidence base using RAG on pgvector, and drafts tailored documents behind a human approval step. Before that, I designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform.

The posting asks for production agents with evaluation and tracing. I built the Job Fit Agent to ship with FastAPI, Postgres, Docker, and Langfuse tracing, plus a daily cost cap. Everything runs on GitHub Actions CI with linting, strict typing, and 70 tests. An eval suite with record/replay gates runs in CI and checks final drafts for zero unsupported claims and for passing injection tests. For customers, I designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform.

The posting also asks for evaluation design across benchmarks, regression suites, and production monitoring. I have built one eval gate for one agent. I have not yet designed model-graded evals or production monitoring for a customer system. My plan is to add model-graded checks and human review to that suite in my first month, then connect Langfuse traces to a monitoring view for each client deployment.
I can discuss travel to client sites as part of the role. Could we set up a short call this week to talk through the first deployment you have in mind?
